title: Create a New Tab in Discord

milestones.goal: Locate the new tab button in the browser.
milestones.done_when: The cursor is hovering over the new tab button, indicated by a plus sign, next to the existing tabs.
hints: click New tab button (plus sign) at the right end of the tab bar
milestones.teach: The new tab button is typically represented by a plus sign and is located next to the existing tabs.

milestones.goal: Click the new tab button to open a new tab.
milestones.done_when: A new blank tab is open and visible in the browser.
hints: click The plus sign (+) new tab button at the right end of the tab bar
milestones.teach: Clicking the new tab button opens a new tab, allowing you to visit a different website without closing the current one.
